served_qa: Synopsis Aging Devil arc Synopsis After defying the orders of Public Safety and undergoing a week of heavy sedation, Denji is sent to the Tokyo Devil Detention Center for dismemberment. While Denji undergoes the slow process of dissection, Takagi, a member of Special Division 7, notes that no Devil has ever escaped from the Detention Center and that breaching it would require a full-scale war. Plot Summary Public Safety Saga Plot Summary Denji is a lonely boy who one day meets a Devil, Pochita. The two end up becoming friends, however Denji is soon killed and to save him, Pochita becomes his new heart, making him a human-devil hybrid and allowing him to become the Chainsaw Man. Soon after that, Denji meets Makima and decides to follow her and join the Public Safety and become a Devil Hunter. At his new job, he makes new friends, like Aki Hayakawa and Power, and together they go on different missions to exterminate devils. Eventually, Aki and Power are killed and Makima is exposed to be the Control Devil, who wants to control the Chainsaw Devil. Denji is then forced to fight and defeat Makima and her new squad of hybrids. Summary Chapter 218 Summary As the battle rages on, Asa orders Denji to eat her, believing she is already as good as dead. Despite all of her bonding, she knows that Yoru will never willingly return her body to her. Asa also believes that even if the Death Devil wipes out humanity, Denji could still survive. Still in disbelief, Denji asks her what would happen to her, and she admits that, due to the overwhelming guilt she feels over her actions, she simply doesn’t care anymore. However, since she wishes to go out doing something good, she urges Denji to eat her as she takes advantage of Yoru. In the real world, Yoru revives once more as Famine uses some of her own blood to accelerate Pochita’s recovery. She yells at Famine for being too weak and for sullying her holy war, but the Famine Devil retorts that Yoru is the true weakling as she revs Pochita’s ripcord herself. Before Yoru can retaliate, Asa momentarily regains control and turns her finger on herself, blowing off the top half of her head. Miri then intervenes, bisecting the War Devil’s body before instructing Death to deploy Guilly. In response, the Death Devil summons the Guillotine Devil and orders it to mince Yoru’s body. The Death Devil’s allies subsequently tell Chainsaw Man to consume her, but he decapitates them instead, making it clear that, in one way or another, he intends to save Asa. Synopsis Episode 1 Synopsis Denji is a teenager who lives his life as a Devil Hunter. Aiming to pay off the debt he inherited from his father, he starts hunting devils for the yakuza with his buddy Pochita, a "Chainsaw Devil", while living a tragically poor life. Just when things seem like they couldn't get any worse, Denji gets betrayed and killed by the yakuza. As Denji starts passing out, he hears someone calling from inside his head... She is, however, very fond of cats and would rather kill a human than a cat.(Chapter 112) Asa later admits to herself that her mean-spirited attitude towards her peers was a result of jealousy and a lack of belonging. She also suffers from low self-esteem and considers herself to be clumsy. Despite this, Asa can be falsely self-assured and overconfident, such as her belief that she would easily be able to seduce Denji. When the public gives her the recognition she yearns for, she initially claims to dislike being popular, but then smiles while watching people on TV praising her. Asa can be extremely socially inept, so much so that Yoru, the War Devil, shows more social awareness than her despite having limited knowledge about humanity. For example, she believes that giving Denji long lectures about ocean facts on their aquarium date would be a great way to win his affection. Over time, Asa becomes a skilled manipulator, coercing Katana Man to betray Public Safety by taking advantage of his hatred towards Chainsaw Man, claiming she wants to fight Chainsaw Man herself. served_qa: Personality Fami Personality Fami has a very mysterious personality and shows little outward emotion. She is always calm, cold, and composed and also seems to be very good at reading others, as she accurately describes both Asa's and Denji's characters.(Chapter 113) Her knowledge seems greater than she initially leads on, as she possesses information that shouldn't be available to her. Fami doesn't care if someone discovers her true identity and therefore puts little to no effort into her alias. What's more is that she doesn't necessarily seem to be as outwardly malicious as her brethren, even informing Public Safety officials such as Yoshida about more dangerous Devils, albeit after being threatened first.(Chapter 122) Despite being intelligent, she can underestimate others, believing that Asa, like most people, would be willing to do anything to survive if forced to, which gets proven wrong. Fami derives her power from Ypositismosphobia (from Greek υποσιτισμός: "malnutrition"), the fear of hunger or starvation. Fami has supernatural and religious elements tied to her character, most notably her wanting to save people from suffering via death, as the concept of starvation reduces human need to its most basic, undeniable, human level — survival. This extreme need for mere existence can be paralleled with the absolute, all-consuming nature of faith or ultimate concerns like life and death, reflecting a warped, fatalistic benevolence tied to basic human survival. Personality Famine Devil Personality Fami has a meek and taciturn demeanor and is very outwardly emotional, in stark contrast with her sisters. She was nervous when introducing herself to students of Fourth East High School, crying throughout her entire introduction and openly bawling when she saw that nobody was paying attention to her. At the same time, she appears to have somewhat of a high opinion of herself, refusing to take out the trash because it would be a waste of her superior talents.
